name: P R I S M
source:
P R I S M (or PRISM) is a Visual Novel game set in a fantasy world where dragons, elves, and magic is the norm.

Freyja is a young traveler making her way to The Palace of the Grey: a place called the city of opportunity by many. On her journey, she becomes stuck in the town called Avon-On-Reach when a sudden fog descends upon the town.

As she gets to know the residence, she soon starts to wonder if there's more to the fog than meets the eye, and if it has a connection to the strange happenings around the town.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1956840/]Steam[/url]]
